order_status.description: Multi-turn flow to look up and provide order tracking status

required_slots.name: order_id
required_slots.prompt: Could you please provide your Order ID? (e.g., #QD-1234 or ORD-5678)
required_slots.reprompt: I didn't quite catch a valid Order ID. Please provide your order number in a format like #QD-1234 or ORD-5678.

order_status.success_message: Thank you! I found your order {order_id}. Your shipment is currently In Transit and scheduled for delivery within 2 business days. Tracking details have also been sent to your email.
order_status.failure_message: I was unable to find an active order matching {order_id}. Please verify the number or let me know if you'd like me to connect you with an agent.

return_request.description: Multi-turn flow to initiate an item return and generate shipping label

required_slots.name: order_id
required_slots.prompt: I can help you start a return. What is your Order ID? (e.g., #QD-1234)
required_slots.reprompt: Please provide a valid Order ID (e.g., #QD-1234 or ORD-5678) so I can locate the purchase.

required_slots.name: reason
required_slots.prompt: What is the reason for your return? (e.g., wrong size, defective item, changed mind, not as described)
required_slots.reprompt: Could you briefly describe the reason for returning the item so we can process your label?

return_request.success_message: Your return request for order {order_id} has been approved (Reason: {reason}). A prepaid return shipping label has been generated and emailed to your address. Please drop off the package within 14 days.
return_request.failure_message: We could not process the return for order {order_id} automatically. This may be because the 30-day window has expired. Would you like me to connect you with a representative?

refund_status.description: Multi-turn flow to check the status of a pending or processed refund

required_slots.name: order_id_or_email
required_slots.prompt: To check your refund status, please provide your Order ID (e.g., #QD-1234) or the email address linked to your account.
required_slots.reprompt: Please enter a valid Order ID (e.g., #QD-1234) or email address (e.g., user@example.com).

refund_status.success_message: Good news! The refund for {order_id_or_email} has been approved and processed back to your original payment method. Depending on your bank, it should reflect in your account within 3-5 business days.
refund_status.failure_message: I could not locate an active refund record for {order_id_or_email}. If your return package was delivered recently, please allow 48 hours for inspection.

billing_issue.description: Multi-turn flow to investigate billing discrepancies or duplicate charges

required_slots.name: order_id_or_transaction_id
required_slots.prompt: I can help investigate this billing charge. Could you share your Order ID (#QD-1234) or Transaction ID (TXN-5678)?
required_slots.reprompt: Please provide a valid Order ID (e.g., ORD-1234) or Transaction ID (e.g., TXN-9988) so our billing system can locate the charges.

billing_issue.success_message: I have audited the records for {order_id_or_transaction_id}. Our billing system shows an adjustment is in progress and any erroneous charge will be automatically reversed to your statement within 2-3 business days.
billing_issue.failure_message: I could not automatically resolve the charge for {order_id_or_transaction_id}. I have created high-priority billing ticket #BILL-4492 and flagged it for our finance department.

cancel_order.description: Multi-turn flow to cancel an order within the eligible cancellation window

required_slots.name: order_id
required_slots.prompt: Please provide the Order ID of the order you would like to cancel (e.g., #QD-1234).
required_slots.reprompt: Please enter a valid Order ID (e.g., #QD-1234 or ORD-5678) to proceed with cancellation.

required_slots.name: confirmation
required_slots.prompt: Are you sure you want to cancel order {order_id}? Please reply 'yes' to confirm or 'no' to keep your order.
required_slots.reprompt: Please respond with 'yes' or 'confirm' to cancel your order, or 'no' to cancel this request.

cancel_order.success_message: Order {order_id} has been successfully cancelled! A full refund has been initiated to your original payment method, and a cancellation confirmation has been sent to your email.
cancel_order.failure_message: We were unable to cancel order {order_id} because it has already reached the fulfillment/shipping stage. Once it arrives, you can use our free returns portal to return it.

account_help.description: Multi-turn flow to handle account recovery, password reset, and settings update

required_slots.name: email_or_username
required_slots.prompt: Please share your registered email address or username so I can locate your account.
required_slots.reprompt: Please enter a valid email address (e.g., name@domain.com) or your account username.

account_help.success_message: We have sent a secure password reset link and account recovery instructions to the email associated with {email_or_username}. The link will remain active for 30 minutes.
account_help.failure_message: No account was found matching {email_or_username}. Please double-check the spelling or create a new account.
